props.html:
Enquiry received

Thank you — that's off your plate

We've received your enquiry and passed it to event planners who cover your area and are available around your date. Keep an eye on your inbox — and check your junk folder, just in case.

  • 01Your enquiry is inIt's been sent to planners who cover your area and work on your kind of event. Nothing else is needed from you right now.
  • 02You'll hear back within 24–48 hoursUsually sooner. Each planner will come back with their pricing, what's included at your chosen level, and how they'd approach your event.
  • 03Compare properly, then chooseLook at fit as much as price — you'll be talking to this person for months. There's no obligation to book any of them.
  • 04Hand it overOnce you've chosen, the list stops being yours. That's the whole point.
